newsitem.title: NORWAY: Saga restarts North Sea Tordis oilfield.
newsitem.headline: Saga restarts North Sea Tordis oilfield.

text.p: Saga Petroleum ASA said on Tuesday it had resumed crude production at the Tordis oilfield in the North Sea following scheduled maintenance.
Tordis was shut down on October 11 at the same time as the Gullfaks development was closed for turnaround. Tordis feeds crude to Gullfaks C for processing and transportation.
"We began start up last night," a Saga spokeswoman said. "We will bring five wells on stream one after the other. When that is complete production will be about 90,000 barrels per day (bpd)."
In September Tordis pumped an average 74,047 bpd.
